description: Per-event mass-uncertainty calibration of AN-16-442 5.3: pairs with both legs in the same lambda region, binned in the predicted relative mass uncertainty e = 0.5 sqrt((dpT1/pT1)^2 + (dpT2/pT2)^2); each bin's resolution from a BW (x) DCB fit (data and MC separately, MC tails fixed in the data fit), lambda = the slope of the fitted sigma against m_Z <e>.  Muon regions: |eta| 0-0.9-1.8-2.4 (AN); electron regions: |eta_SC| below or above 1.0, each split by the relative energy error at 0.03 (below 1.0) or 0.07 (above), the AN ECAL-/tracker-driven proxy (UL NanoAOD has no ecalDriven flag).
